about_the_game:
Someone farts. Someone dies. And it’s no accident.
Welcome to Who Fart, an online multiplayer game where one player secretly takes on the role of The Farter — a sneaky saboteur who can poison rooms with nothing but visible, deadly gas clouds.

The other players — just regular folks (or so they seem) — must complete simple tasks in places like luxurious villas or sterile office buildings.
But beware: an unventilated room could become your tomb !

While you're making tea or tidying the game room, The Farter is closing windows, blending in, pretending to be busy… and waiting for the perfect moment to trap you in a cloud of doom. Can you unmask the traitor before it’s too late?

💥 Features:

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Online multiplayer (4 to 10 players)
💨 One traitor among you… and no second chances
🏠 Maps: villa, open space office, and more to come
🌬️ Dynamic ventilation system: open the windows, stay alive
🎮 Interactive minigames for every task
😂 A dumb concept with surprisingly serious mechanics

Nothing smells right here.
And that’s exactly the point.

Who Fart — track the fart… or be the fart.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4–6 GB)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
